abstract: Cis-platinum, vinblastine, bleomycin and actinomycin D were used in the treatment of 24 patients with advanced testicular tumors. There were 8 seminomas and 16 nonseminomas. 19 patients were in stage III B, 2 in stage III A and 3 in stage II B. 7 patients were previously treated. Complete remission was obtained in 12 patients (50%), partial remission in 8 (33%) and treatment failed in 4 (16.7%). According to localization of metastases best results were obtained in patients with lung metastases (11 complete remissions out of 16 patients). Nausea, vomiting and alopecia were the most frequent toxic side effects of treatment. The authors hope that the 9 patients who are still in complete remission have good chances for complete recovery.
abstract_ja: シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、アクチノマイシンDを、進行精巣腫瘍の患者24例の治療に用いた。内訳はセミノーマ8例、非セミノーマ16例であった。病期は、病期IIIBが19例、病期IIIAが2例、病期IIBが3例であった。7例は前治療を受けていた。完全寛解は12例(50%)で得られ、部分寛解は8例(33%)、治療不成功は4例(16.7%)であった。転移部位別にみると、肺転移例で最も良好な成績が得られた(16例中11例で完全寛解)。主な毒性は、悪心、嘔吐、脱毛であった。現時点で完全寛解を維持している9例については、良好な治癒の可能性が期待される。
